start.speaker: Customer
start.text: Someone keeps turning me down. I was hoping we could make a cake to change her mind.

start.speaker: Fairy
start.text: Absolutely not. I’ll make something to improve your appeal, not disable her judgment. Though I appreciate the latter would be easier.

good_result.speaker: Fairy
good_result.text: If this doesn’t work, come back. We’ll try something more drastic. Like making you a decent human being.

bad_result.speaker: Fairy
bad_result.text: That one’s for regrets. Take it to your mother.

hint.speaker: Fairy
hint.text: Calm those nerves and stir a little desire.
